import numpy as np
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Star, Planet


class StarWithOrbitingPlanet(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#05071a"

        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=65 * DEGREES, theta=-80 * DEGREES)

        title = Text("Star with Orbiting Planet", font_size=30, color=WHITE)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title)
        title.to_corner(UL, buff=0.35)

        props = VGroup(
            Text("Mass:  1.0 M\u2609", font_size=18, color=YELLOW_A),
            Text("Temp:  5 778 K",     font_size=18, color=ORANGE),
            Text("Orbit: 3.5 AU",      font_size=18, color=TEAL_A),
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.18)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(props)
        props.to_corner(UR, buff=0.35)

        star = Star(
            center=ORIGIN,
            radius=0.7,
            num_of_particles=120,
            size_of_particle=0.018,
            colors=[YELLOW, ORANGE, RED_A],
            luminosity=0.95,
            mass=1.0,
            temperature=5778,
        )

        a, b = 3.2, 2.0
        orbit = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([a * np.cos(t), b * np.sin(t), 0.0]),
            t_range=[0, TAU],
            color=TEAL_A,
            stroke_width=1.2,
            stroke_opacity=0.6,
        )

        planet = Planet(
            center=[a, 0.0, 0.0],
            radius=0.22,
            include_planetary_disc=False,
        )
        planet.set_color(BLUE_B)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(star),
            Write(title),
            run_time=1.2,
        )

        self.play(
            Create(orbit, run_time=1.5),
            FadeIn(props),
        )

        self.play(FadeIn(planet, run_time=0.6))

        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)

        def planet_updater(mob):
            t = t_tracker.get_value()
            mob.move_to(np.array([a * np.cos(t), b * np.sin(t), 0.0]))

        planet.add_updater(planet_updater)

        self.play(
            t_tracker.animate.set_value(1.5 * PI),
            run_time=4.0,
            rate_func=linear,
        )
        planet.remove_updater(planet_updater)

        self.move_camera(
            phi=45 * DEGREES,
            theta=-60 * DEGREES,
            run_time=1.2,
        )

        self.wait(0.8)

import numpy as np
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Planet


class RingedPlanetScene(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#050a1a"

        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=75 * DEGREES, theta=-90 * DEGREES)

        title = Text("Gas Giant with Planetary Ring", font_size=28, color=WHITE)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title)
        title.to_corner(UL, buff=0.35)

        subtitle = Text("manim-astronomy  \u2022  Planet class", font_size=16, color=GREY_B)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(subtitle)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.12)

        label_radius  = Text("Radius:  0.55 AU", font_size=16, color=BLUE_B)
        label_ring    = Text("Ring: 0.75 \u2013 1.1 AU", font_size=16, color=GOLD_A)
        label_class   = Text("Class: Gas Giant",   font_size=16, color=PURPLE_A)
        info = VGroup(label_radius, label_ring, label_class).arrange(
            DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.15)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(info)
        info.to_corner(UR, buff=0.35)

        planet = Planet(
            center=ORIGIN,
            radius=0.55,
            include_planetary_disc=True,
            ring_inner_radius=0.75,
            ring_outer_radius=1.1,
            num_particles=220,
            size_of_particle=0.015,
        )
        planet.set_color(BLUE_D)
        for p in planet.planetary_disc:
            p.set_color(np.random.choice([GOLD_A, GOLD_B, YELLOW_E, WHITE]))

        eq_ring = Circle(radius=0.57, color=BLUE_A, stroke_width=1.0,
                         stroke_opacity=0.5)
        eq_ring.rotate(PI / 2, RIGHT)

        axis_line = Line(
            start=np.array([0, 0, -1.1]),
            end=np.array([0, 0,  1.1]),
            color=GREY_A, stroke_width=0.6, stroke_opacity=0.45,
        )

        moon_a, moon_b = 3.2, 2.0
        moon_orbit = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([moon_a * np.cos(t), moon_b * np.sin(t), 0.0]),
            t_range=[0, TAU],
            color=GREY_C,
            stroke_width=0.6,
            stroke_opacity=0.45,
        )

        moon = Dot3D(point=[moon_a, 0, 0], radius=0.12, color=GREY_A)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(planet),
            Create(eq_ring),
            Create(axis_line),
            Write(title),
            Write(subtitle),
            run_time=1.5,
        )

        self.play(
            FadeIn(info),
            Create(moon_orbit),
            FadeIn(moon),
            run_time=1.5,
        )

        self.move_camera(phi=55 * DEGREES, theta=-70 * DEGREES, run_time=1.5)

        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)

        def moon_updater(mob):
            t = t_tracker.get_value()
            mob.move_to(np.array([moon_a * np.cos(t),
                                  moon_b * np.sin(t), 0.0]))

        moon.add_updater(moon_updater)

        self.play(
            t_tracker.animate.set_value(TAU),
            run_time=5.0,
            rate_func=linear,
        )
        moon.remove_updater(moon_updater)

        self.move_camera(phi=40 * DEGREES, theta=-50 * DEGREES, run_time=1.2)

        self.wait(0.8)

description: A ThreeDScene that first builds a flat teal SpaceTimeFabric wireframe (22×22 resolution, func=constant 0) and then morphs it into a gravitational potential well using ReplacementTransform — the warped version uses func= −GM/r with scaling_factor=0.07, producing a visually dramatic funnel. A yellow Dot3D mass sits at the funnel mouth and a white Dot3D test particle follows a ParametricFunction ellipse around it via a ValueTracker updater. Two move_camera calls change phi from 72° to 62° then 35° to reveal the well's depth from different angles. The equation Δg ∝ −GM/r is shown as a fixed-frame Text label in the upper-right corner. import numpy as np
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import SpaceTimeFabric


def _grav(u, v, mass=40.0, eps=0.18):
    r = np.sqrt(u ** 2 + v ** 2 + eps)
    return -mass / r


class SpaceTimeGravityWell(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#030b18"

        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=72 * DEGREES, theta=-85 * DEGREES)

        title = Text("Spacetime Curvature \u2014 Gravity Well", font_size=27, color=WHITE)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title)
        title.to_corner(UL, buff=0.3)

        eq_label = Text("\u0394g  \u221d  \u2212GM / r", font_size=20, color=TEAL_A)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(eq_label)
        eq_label.to_corner(UR, buff=0.3)

        note = Text("SpaceTimeFabric  \u2022  manim-astronomy", font_size=14, color=GREY_B)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(note)
        note.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.25)

        fabric_flat = SpaceTimeFabric(
            func=lambda u, v: 0.0,
            u_range=(-2.5, 2.5),
            v_range=(-2.5, 2.5),
            resolution=(22, 22),
            scaling_factor=0.3,
            t_range=(-2.5, 2.5),
            stroke_color=TEAL_B,
        )

        fabric_warped = SpaceTimeFabric(
            func=_grav,
            u_range=(-2.5, 2.5),
            v_range=(-2.5, 2.5),
            resolution=(22, 22),
            scaling_factor=0.07,
            t_range=(-2.5, 2.5),
            stroke_color=TEAL_B,
        )

        mass_dot = Dot3D(point=[0, 0, 0], radius=0.18, color=YELLOW)

        orb_a, orb_b = 1.8, 1.2
        orbit_path = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([orb_a * np.cos(t), orb_b * np.sin(t), 0.0]),
            t_range=[0, TAU],
            color=GOLD_A,
            stroke_width=0.8,
            stroke_opacity=0.55,
        )
        test_dot = Dot3D(point=[orb_a, 0, 0], radius=0.09, color=WHITE)

        self.play(
            Create(fabric_flat),
            Write(title),
            Write(eq_label),
            Write(note),
            run_time=2.0,
        )
        self.wait(0.4)

        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(fabric_flat, fabric_warped),
            FadeIn(mass_dot),
            run_time=2.5,
        )

        self.move_camera(phi=62 * DEGREES, theta=-70 * DEGREES, run_time=1.5)

        self.play(
            Create(orbit_path),
            FadeIn(test_dot),
            run_time=1.0,
        )

        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0.0)

        def orb_updater(mob):
            t = t_tracker.get_value()
            mob.move_to(np.array([orb_a * np.cos(t), orb_b * np.sin(t), 0.0]))

        test_dot.add_updater(orb_updater)
        self.play(
            t_tracker.animate.set_value(TAU),
            run_time=5.0,
            rate_func=linear,
        )
        test_dot.remove_updater(orb_updater)

        self.move_camera(phi=35 * DEGREES, theta=-50 * DEGREES, run_time=1.2)

        self.wait(0.8)

import numpy as np
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import HubbleSpaceTelescope


class HubbleTelescope3D(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#020710"

        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=70 * DEGREES, theta=-100 * DEGREES)

        title = Text("Hubble Space Telescope", font_size=30, color=WHITE)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(title)
        title.to_corner(UL, buff=0.35)

        subtitle = Text("Low-Earth Orbit  \u2022  ~600 km altitude", font_size=16, color=GREY_B)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(subtitle)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.12)

        stats = VGroup(
            Text("Launch:  April 24, 1990", font_size=16, color=BLUE_B),
            Text("Mirror:  2.4 m primary",  font_size=16, color=TEAL_A),
            Text("Agency:  NASA / ESA",      font_size=16, color=GOLD_A),
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.14)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(stats)
        stats.to_corner(UR, buff=0.35)

        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        star_positions = rng.uniform(-5.5, 5.5, size=(60, 3))
        star_positions[:, 2] = rng.uniform(-3, -1, size=60)
        stars = VGroup(*[
            Dot3D(point=pos, radius=0.018,
                  color=np.random.choice([WHITE, GREY_A, YELLOW_A]))
            for pos in star_positions
        ])

        hubble = HubbleSpaceTelescope(center=ORIGIN, size=0.45)
        hubble.set_color(GREY_A)

        orb_a, orb_b = 4.5, 2.8
        orbit_arc = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([orb_a * np.cos(t), orb_b * np.sin(t), 0.0]),
            t_range=[-PI * 0.6, PI * 0.6],
            color=BLUE_C,
            stroke_width=0.9,
            stroke_opacity=0.45,
        )

        earth = Dot3D(point=[0, -4.0, 0], radius=1.1, color=BLUE_D)
        earth.set_opacity(0.75)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(stars, run_time=0.8),
            FadeIn(earth, run_time=0.8),
            Write(title),
            Write(subtitle),
        )

        self.play(
            FadeIn(hubble, run_time=1.0),
            Create(orbit_arc, run_time=1.2),
            FadeIn(stats),
        )

        self.play(
            Rotate(hubble, angle=PI, axis=UP, run_time=3.0, rate_func=smooth),
        )

        self.move_camera(phi=40 * DEGREES, theta=-60 * DEGREES, run_time=2.0)

        self.play(
            Rotate(hubble, angle=PI / 2, axis=RIGHT, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth),
        )

        self.move_camera(phi=20 * DEGREES, theta=-45 * DEGREES, run_time=1.5)

        self.wait(0.8)
